prompt: Build a logistic regression model to predict treatment response. Use synthetic clinical data with features: Age, Baseline SLEDAI, CRP, Anti-dsDNA, C3, Prior Biologics, Disease Duration, Renal Involvement. Show me the full evaluation.
assertions: Reports AUC-ROC as a number between 0 and 1
Reports 5-fold CV AUC mean and standard deviation
Shows confusion matrix with TP/TN/FP/FN values
Shows coefficient table sorted by absolute value
Uses StandardScaler fitted on training data only
